description: Camila herself, waist up in a white shirt, smiling at the camera.
suggest: The human anchor: stand her on the bottom edge of a hero or the About opener and layer scraps around her.

description: Top-down view of Camila bent over the green cutting mat, craft knife in hand, slicing magazine faces; her hair fills the top and is cut flat by the photo edge.
suggest: The signature "at work" piece: hang it from the top edge of a section so the hair bleeds off the page.

description: Both of her hands, rings and bead bracelets on, placing eye and lip scraps on the cutting mat; the forearms are cut flat at the top.
suggest: A process moment for Commissions or Services; let the arms come in from the top edge.

description: Her left hand alone, big silver ring and painted nails, reaching down from the upper right; the wrist is cut straight.
suggest: A hand that reaches into a layout from a corner to "hold" a card, a heading or a scrap.

description: The whole green cutting mat seen from above with magazine eyes, lips and torn strips laid out on it.
suggest: A ready-made collage table: use it as a hero object or as the "surface" behind a heading.

description: The same cutting mat photographed at an angle, fragments arranged on it, one corner running off the frame.
suggest: A tilted mat for a corner of a section where the straight-on one feels too flat.

description: Her black-handled scissors, closed, with see-through finger holes.
suggest: A small tool accent beside a "cut here" line, a divider or a button; rotates well.

description: One loose magazine scrap: a grey eye and brow on a tilted four-sided cut.
suggest: Scatter piece: an eye that watches the visitor from a margin, a card corner or the cart.

description: A second loose eye scrap, smaller and squarer than the first.
suggest: Pair it with scrap-eye and scrap-lips to build a face out of pieces.

description: A loose magazine scrap of nude-pink lips cut to a leaf shape (small file).
suggest: Tiny scatter accent; completes the scrap face with the two eyes.

description: A framed original lying at an angle: the orange-haired collage "Candy" in a red frame with a white mount.
suggest: Shows what a buyer receives; good on Shop or Home next to the shipping line. It shows a whole piece, so caption it.

description: A dense Local Collage piece in its ornate black frame, photographed at the exhibition.
suggest: The object for The Local Collage section on Exhibition and the Home teaser.

description: The green knitted cactus with pink blossoms and paper thorns, lifted from "Female Cactus".
suggest: A bold standalone object: grows up from a bottom edge, pops on orange, cobalt and paper alike.

description: The woman whose head blooms into flowers and pink jewels, from "Tears Water The Soul - Pink".
suggest: A portrait-scale figure for a hero or a section opener; the source file is small, so do not show it wider than its real width.

description: The woman crowned with watches, gold coins, cars and silver flowers, from "Tears Water The Soul - Silver".
suggest: A second head-and-shoulders figure; sits well on a bottom edge beside a headline.

description: The woman masked in green brocade, moss and midnight blue with paper teardrops falling, from "Tears Water The Soul - Green".
suggest: The richest of the three heads; large enough for a hero. A few pale teardrops the lift had left see-through were put back from the original picture.

description: A red admiral butterfly resting on a yellow flower with its long stem, from "The Art of Art".
suggest: Grows up from a bottom edge or peeks over the top of a card; the stem makes a natural divider.

description: A black quill pen with a silver nib, still wearing its pale blue hand-cut paper edge, from "The Art of Art".
suggest: A light diagonal accent next to the artist statement, a signature line or the contact form.

description: A laughing woman on a wicker stool with a tiger leaning across her lap, from "Senor Tigre".
suggest: A scene in one piece: big, warm and funny beside a headline or as the surprise in an empty state.

description: A tiger walking to the right, cut as the magazine strip it is: flat along the back and at the legs, from "Senor Tigre".
suggest: Walks along the bottom edge of a section or the top of the footer; hide the flat leg cut on that edge.

description: A tiger coming straight at you, head and shoulders, with visible magazine print dots; cut flat on the right and at the bottom, from "Senor Tigre".
suggest: Peeks in from a left or bottom edge; keep the flat sides against the edge of the page or a card.

description: Dark red lips biting a finger, with the whole hand and red nails, from "Lucky Pleasures".
suggest: The loudest piece in the set: a hero accent, a 404, or the mark beside "add to cart".

description: A figure seen from behind with long blue hair and a varsity jacket with a grinning monster on the back, from "I Am The Bad Guy".
suggest: A visitor looking at the art: stand it at the bottom of a gallery or shop grid, facing the work.

description: Three people seen from behind, a child pointing up, a man shading his eyes and a little girl, from "Curiosity".
suggest: Small viewers at the foot of a big picture; they give any artwork above them the feeling of a gallery wall.

description: A black-and-white graphic hand with spread fingers and a torn white paper edge, from "Modern Love".
suggest: Reaches up from the bottom edge of a section or a footer; strong on orange and cobalt.

description: A woman from behind in a black dress with a white snake down the back, with her pale paper silhouette beside her, from "Reflections of Me".
suggest: A tall, calm figure for a narrow column: beside the artist statement or a product story.

description: A face in two strips, calm closed eyes in black and white above, a red-orange shouting mouth below, from "Let Out".
suggest: A tall shout for a left edge (its left side is straight). It is orange itself, so put it on cobalt or paper.

description: A man sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed and a loudspeaker for a halo, from "Stuck".
suggest: A quiet, funny figure for an empty cart, a "sent" message or a waiting state.
